title: Dabang Property Scraper
description:
Scrape Dabang (다방) Korean real-estate into clean structured datasets — rooms, officetels and apartments with deposit/rent (월세·전세), exact coordinates, addresses, nearest subway and photos. One run, one clean dataset out. No account or API key needed.

🎯 **Use Cases:** rental market research · investment comps · price tracking · lead generation · proptech datasets · relocation search

scrapeMode.title: 🔭 Scrape mode
scrapeMode.description:
🔭 **OVERVIEW** (recommended, cheapest): paginate the map search and return rich listing cards — price, type, neighborhood, approximate location, photos and flags. Each card already carries most of the data.

🔎 **DETAIL**: everything in Overview PLUS the full listing — exclusive area, rooms & baths, total floors, full description, options, exact location and nearest subway. Unfetchable listings are billed as Overview.
enumTitles: 🔎 Detail — full listing: area, rooms, description, exact location

category.title: 🏠 Property category
category.description:
🏠 Which Dabang surface to scrape.

- **one-two** — studios & two-rooms (원룸·투룸), the default residential rental surface
- **officetel** — 오피스텔 units
- **apt** — apartment complexes (아파트)

place.title: 🔍 Place / neighborhood name
place.description:
🔍 **SEARCH BY PLACE:** A Korean place, district or station name (e.g. `강남구`, `역삼동`, `홍대입구역`). The actor resolves it to a map area automatically.

💡 **TIP:** Leave blank to use the default Gangnam (강남) area, or provide a center point / search URL instead.
place.sectionDescription: Pick ONE: a place name, a center point, or a captured search URL. If none is given, a default Gangnam area is used.

centerLat.title: 📐 Center latitude
centerLat.description: 📐 Latitude of the map center to search around (used with Center longitude). Overrides Place when both lat/lng are set.

centerLng.title: 📐 Center longitude
centerLng.description: 📐 Longitude of the map center to search around (used with Center latitude).

searchUrl.title: 🔗 Captured Dabang search URL (advanced)
searchUrl.description: 🔗 **ADVANCED:** Paste a captured Dabang map/list API URL (`…/room-list/category/<cat>/bbox?filters=…&bbox=…`). The actor preserves its exact area + filters. Overrides Place / Center.

sellingTypes.title: 💳 Deal type (월세 / 전세 / 매매)
sellingTypes.description:
💳 Which deal types to include.

- **MONTHLY_RENT** — 월세 (monthly rent + deposit)
- **LEASE** — 전세 (jeonse / charter, large deposit, no monthly)
- **SHORT_RENT** — 단기 (short-term)
- **SELL** — 매매 (sale price; officetel & apartment categories)
sellingTypes.sectionDescription: Optional. Narrow results by deal type, price, room type and amenities. Amounts are in 만원 (10,000 KRW). Filter fields adapt to the property category (rooms / officetel / apartment), matching Dabang's live filter set.

roomTypes.title: 🛏️ Room type
roomTypes.description: 🛏️ Room layouts to include (원룸 / 투룸 / 쓰리룸…).

depositMin.title: 💰 Deposit min (만원)
depositMin.description: 💰 Minimum deposit (보증금) in 만원 (10,000 KRW). e.g. 1000 = 10,000,000 KRW.

rentMin.title: 💵 Monthly rent min (만원)
rentMin.description: 💵 Minimum monthly rent (월세) in 만원 (10,000 KRW).

rentMax.title: 💵 Monthly rent max (만원)
rentMax.description: 💵 Maximum monthly rent (월세) in 만원 (10,000 KRW).

roomUrls.title: 🔗 Specific room URLs / IDs (Detail mode)
roomUrls.description:
🔗 **DETAIL BY URL:** Provide specific Dabang room URLs (`https://www.dabangapp.com/room/<id>`) or bare room IDs to enrich exactly those listings. Use with Detail mode. Overrides the area search.

📋 Click **Bulk edit** to paste one per line.
roomUrls.sectionDescription: Detail mode only — enrich a fixed set of rooms instead of searching an area.

maxResults.title: 🔢 Max results
maxResults.description:
🔢 Maximum listings to return.

**FREE users:** up to 25 per run. **PAID users:** unlimited.

maxPages.title: 📄 Max search pages (0 = until Max results)
maxPages.description: 📄 Hard cap on search pages to paginate (24 listings each). 0 = paginate until Max results is reached or there are no more.
